fieldContext.note: Replaces the binary functional/nonfunctional distinction with a 10-layer ontology: 1. Business Goals, 2. Stakeholder Needs, 3. Behavioral Reqs, 4. Quality Attributes, 5. Legal/Technical Constraints, 6. Transition Reqs, 7. Operational Reqs, 8. Safety/Security/Ethics Obligations, 9. Data/AI Reqs, 10. Assumptions & Hypotheses.
fieldContext.source: BABOK v3 / Modern Software Engineering Practice

personalNotes: A multi-layer classification prevents cross-cutting concerns like privacy or security from being marginalized under a generic 'non-functional' bucket.
